in_sanskrit.name: ईलेश्री
in_sanskrit.meaning: ईले (Eile) + श्री (Shri) = Famous, Prosperous, Wealthy + ई (I) + ले (Le) + श्री (Shri) = In all worlds
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Eleshri is derived from the Sanskrit words ईले (Eile) and श्री (Shri). Eile means 'Famous, Prosperous, Wealthy'. Shri is a prefix meaning 'Goddess of wealth, fortune and prosperity'. The name Eleshri, therefore, means 'Famous in all worlds'. It is a powerful and auspicious name, signifying one who is renowned and respected in all realms of existence.

in_hindi.name: एलेश्री
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Eleshri in Hindi translates to 'Revered One, Protector of all Worlds'. It is a name that evokes respect and awe, signifying one who is held in high regard and is a guardian of all realms of existence.

in_tamil.name: ஈலேஷ்ரி
in_tamil.meaning: இல்லையே (Illaiye) + ஶ்ரீ (Shri) = Not lacking + Goddess of wealth, fortune and prosperity = Famous and prosperous in all worlds
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Eleshri in Tamil translates to 'Not lacking and Goddess of wealth, fortune and prosperity'. The name is derived from the Tamil words ஈல்லையே (Illaiye) which means 'Not lacking' and ஶ்ரீ (Shri) which is a prefix meaning 'Goddess of wealth, fortune and prosperity'. The name Eleshri signifies one who is famous and prosperous in all worlds, and is endowed with all the blessings of the Goddess of wealth and prosperity.

in_telugu.name: ేలేశ్రీ
in_telugu.meaning: ేళ్ళే (Elle) + శ్రీ (Shri) = Famous + Goddess of wealth, fortune and prosperity = Famous and prosperous in all worlds
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Eleshri in Telugu translates to 'Famous and Goddess of wealth, fortune and prosperity'. The name is derived from the Telugu words ేళ్ళే (Elle) which means 'Famous' and శ్రీ (Shri) which is a prefix meaning 'Goddess of wealth, fortune and prosperity'. The name Eleshri signifies one who is famous and prosperous in all worlds, and is endowed with all the blessings of the Goddess of wealth and prosperity.
